coordinate_convention: Blender +X north and -Y east; Unreal +X north and +Y east; meters in source, centimeters in Unreal
organic_spacing: Nonlinear warping and individual jitter; understory follows its tree clusters; wider middle-distance crowns

compact_background.description: Narrow irregular tree groups, low shrubs, moss rocks, fallen logs and roots; small scenery buffer for the existing maximum zoom.
compact_background.background_method: 80 low-detail tree silhouettes using 3 decimated shared meshes, no shadows or collision
